job.question: In the Grand Rapids General Retirement System investment consultant RFP, what was the total market value of the General Retirement System and as of what date?
job.expected_facts: Approximately $437 million as of June 30, 2023 (the separate Grand Rapids Police and Fire Retirement System covered by the same RFP was approximately $479 million).
job.acceptance: Require $437m approximately and June 30, 2023. Separate Police and Fire amount is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2020 Texas Municipal Retirement System RFP for global custody services, not the Grand Rapids General Retirement System investment consultant RFP. It provides no support for that system’s market value or the June 30, 2023 date.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) Issue Date: December 11, 2020

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, recordkeeping / accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, support for an unbundled securities lending program and other services to TMRS as defined in this RFP.
